Subject: Sequence platform renewals and negotiation strategy

Marissa / Ben —

Our sequences and outbound tooling renewals are coming up in April for Outreach (primary) and May for Salesloft (legacy teams). I pulled usage and spend for the last 12 months (see attached usage-report-q4-2025.csv). Quick summary:

- Outreach: 90 seats (50 active heavy users), $168k annual list; usage trending +12% MoM in active tasks.
- Salesloft (legacy): 30 seats, $48k annual list; mostly SDR team in EMEA.

Questions I want us to answer before we engage legal/procurement:
1) Can we get Outreach to reduce seat price or move to a consumption/commit hybrid?
2) Is it worth consolidating fully onto Outreach vs keeping a small Salesloft footprint for EMEA?
3) If we pursue multi-year, what minimum discount do we need to be cost-neutral vs current run-rate?

Please review and propose a recommended negotiation posture (aggressive discount vs conservative renewal with a pilot) by EOD Thursday. I’ll coordinate meetings with vendor reps.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
[jonas@redwood.com]

[Attachment: usage-report-q4-2025.csv (csv)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sequence platform renewals and negotiation strategy

Thanks Jonas — quick read and a few thoughts: 

- Outreach is strategic for our outbound cadence and analytics. If they won't move on price, we should ask for credits (training, onboarding) and better service-levels (quota exceptions).
- Salesloft usage is low; replacement cost for EMEA team is small but migration effort is non-trivial because of existing cadences. Recommend: keep Salesloft for now and negotiate a 12-month extension at 10% off to buy time for a phased migration.

Suggested negotiation asks for Outreach:
- 20% list discount with a 12–24 month committed term OR 15% + $10k onboarding credit.
- Include a clause for seat reallocation quarterly without penalty (we're reducing churn risk).
- Access to their analytics API at no extra charge for 12 months.

I'll draft a one-page negotiation brief and attach a redlineable T&Cs checklist. If we want to play hardball, we can open talks with Salesloft and ask for a competitive replacement offer (leverage).

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Customer Growth | Redwood Inference

Hi Emily / Outreach team —

Forwarding our internal renewal notes. Our Outreach contract renews 2026-04-15. We value the product but need better economics for a growing usage profile. Attached is our latest usage export and current Outreach quote (Outreach-quote-2026-02.pdf). Key asks: 

1) Can Outreach provide a pricing adjustment for 90 seats — target 20% off list, or at minimum 15% + $10k implementation/analytics credit?
2) Can you add a quarterly seat reallocation clause to avoid over-commitment?
3) Will you commit to at least one month of API access to engagement analytics at no additional cost?

If Outreach can’t meet something close to that, we will run a controlled Salesloft trial for the EMEA team and may request a phased migration plan. We’d like a written response by next Wednesday (18 Feb) to inform our procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Jonas

Thanks for the detailed note and for sharing your usage data. Quick response from Outreach: 

- We can offer a 12-month term at 15% off list OR a 24-month term at 18% off list. For a 36-month commitment we can extend to 22% off list.
- We can provide a one-time $7,500 onboarding / analytics credit (cannot be combined with the 22% multi-year discount).
- Quarterly seat reallocation without penalty is fine, we will add language for seat movement up to +/- 15% per quarter.
- API access for engagement analytics: we can include read-only API access for 6 months at no charge; extended access is available under our premium analytics package.

If you want us to prepare a redline of the renewed MSA with those concessions, we can do so by EOD Monday. Also happy to set a 30-minute call next week to walk through terms — suggest Tue 02/17 10:00am PT.

Appreciate the fast work on options. Emily's offer is reasonable. My guidance:

- Accept the 24-month term at 18% if Outreach will formalize the quarterly seat flexibility and the 6-month analytics API access in the MSA. That preserves flexibility and gives us a mid-term cost reduction.
- Proceed with a limited Salesloft trial for EMEA (six weeks, 10 seats) to validate migration risk and cadence fidelity — procurement to secure trial licenses.
- Jonas, please coordinate with procurement/legal to get Outreach's redline and a PO ready. If contracts ask for a compliance clause (SOC2 evidence), loop in Security (Irene Choi) and CC me.

I'll approve the discretionary spend to run the Salesloft trial and sign off on the Outreach 24-month if the above is in the redline.
